lesson.detail: Projects defined with an inline configuration inherit all options from the root-level configuration; add extends: false to ignore the options.

source.quote: Projects defined with an inline configuration inherit all options from the root-level configuration. This is controlled by the extends option, which is enabled by default since Vitest 5.0:
add "extends: false" to ignore // the options defined in this config file
